- **Choose AI models where you use them (FL-1305):** Visual search, People, Descriptions, AI restoration and Studio each have their own slider, marked Good, Better and Best. The list comes from Frameleaf Cloud, so new models appear by themselves, and each stop shows whether your graphics card, your processor or Frameleaf Cloud will run it.
- **Set up Frameleaf Cloud from the job (FL-1305):** press Run on a Frameleaf Cloud model and one short sheet lists only what's still needed, then takes you back to the job with its price. Each job now asks you to confirm once.
- **Frameleaf Cloud means Cloud only (FL-1305):** choosing Frameleaf Cloud in Where work runs now keeps that work on Frameleaf Cloud, even when one of your own computers could do it.
- **Use your own search model (FL-1305):** administrators can enter a public Hugging Face model for Visual search under Advanced. Frameleaf checks its files and settings before saving, and search says so if the model can't run.
- **Clearer waiting and warnings (FL-1305):** Cloud processing says what's waiting and why, and changing the Visual search or People model warns you first that your library will be read again.
- **Studio captions on Frameleaf Cloud (FL-1304):** price and add captions to a clip from Studio using Frameleaf Cloud.
- **Manager (FL-1303):** accepts any folder mapped into the container.
